facts.claim: Computerisation is linked to a new temporality that works simultaneously with clock time and perhaps presages the move from a disciplinary to control society.
facts.quote: It is shown how computerisation also ushers in a new temporality, which works simultaneously with clock time and perhaps presages the move from a disciplinary to control society.

facts.claim: The use of an intelligent system for managing workplace conflicts improves conflict detection accuracy from 60% to 90%, reduces the number of reported conflicts by 30%, and increases employee satisfaction from 60% to 88%.
facts.quote: The results showed a significant improvement in conflict detection accuracy (from 60% to 90%), a 30% reduction in the number of reported conflicts, and an increase in employee satisfaction (from 60% to 88%).

facts.claim: In the natural-system model, the goals of the organization are not paramount in determining the ordering and patterning of relations in the organization.
facts.quote: In the natural-system model the organization is regarded as a natural whole, or system. Although the goals of the organization are important, they are not paramount in determining the ordering and patterning of relations in the organization.

facts.claim: The growth of nonstandard employment contracts is linked to the 24/7 economy.
facts.quote: The Growth of Nonstandard Employment Contracts and the 24/7 Economy

facts.claim: Industrial sociology is linked to the reporting of the news of industrial management and organization and of labor relations and conflict in a given series of industries in a given time and place.
facts.quote: A good deal of industrial sociology is a reporting of the news of industrial management and organization and of labor relations and conflict in a given series of industries in a given time and place.

research.angle: The sources discuss the evolution of industrial sociology, the 24/7 economy, and technological management of workplace conflict, but they do not provide data on the invention of the weekend.
research.verdict: The provided sources do not contain any information regarding the historical invention or engineering of the weekend.
research.caveat: The sources focus on modern labor trends, industrial sociology theory, and conflict management systems rather than historical labor management structures.
